hints.title: Racing Asynchronous Operations
hints.text: When an asynchronous task may run indefinitely, an independent deadline timer can intervene and terminate the operation early.

hints.title: Promise Race Composition
hints.text: Create a race between the asynchronous invocation fn(...args) and a rejecting timer scheduled for t milliseconds. Whichever settles first dictates the outcome.

hints.title: Rejection Timer Blueprint
hints.text: Return an async function (...args) returning Promise.race([ fn(...args), new Promise((_, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject("Time Limit Exceeded"), t)) ]).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) wrapper scheduling + O(T) underlying task
complexity.notes: Timer and task are evaluated concurrently via Promise.race.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Waiting indefinitely on unconstrained promises leaks microtasks and hangs dependent workflows.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space timeout promise guarantees deterministic upper bound on resolution time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Rejecting with the exact string "Time Limit Exceeded" and forwarding resolve value when under deadline.
